title: Test Objective
text: Define custom objectives that signals must satisfy in test cases, 1 input, {Values} sets the test objective scalar; {Enable} sets the whether the block is enabled, {Display values} displays the contents of values parameter and {Pass through style} sets the whether the block displays an output port in the Simulink. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Enable
params.values: Specify whether the block is enabled on (default) | off

params.name: Values
params.values: Specify the test objective scalar | cell array

params.name: Display values
params.values: Display the contents of values parameter on (default) | off

params.name: Pass through style
params.values: Specify whether the block displays an output port in the Simulink Editor on (default) | off
